title: Concept: Requirement pinned with the arbitrary-equality operator
description: requirements.txt declares a `===` specifier that bypasses version normalisation, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `===` specifier that bypasses version normalisation.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through requirements.txt (pypi).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `===` specifier that bypasses version normalisation.
